cohort: 118 patients with a breech pregnancy at or after 36 weeks of gestation who underwent an ECV attempt and an ultrasound within 21 days at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at the University Hospital Ulm between January 1st 2010 to July 31st 2013.
finding: Increased AFI, at least one prior vaginal delivery, and high estimated fetal weight were significant independent predictors for a successful ECV.
